title: In-site Google Analytic Reporting
body:
Site managers want to have a single place to manage and report on their sites performance.  Additionally, now that Google is sharing less and less data, more companies are moving at least some of their analytic capabilities to google analytics.  Google provides an api that would allow us to build a screen within dotCMS to report on a sites performance without the site manager having to leave dotCMS.
- Provide Site managers a screen that would call google analytics API to render google traffic and analytic data in dotCMS.
- RestPortlet
- I think we will need to use the API becuase the Embed code is tied to a user - we will need app level permissions
- Jason Smith will be the story owner
author: Participant 1
